name: @eip/local-cockpit-server
description: Localhost-only review POC server. Reads production runtime D1 (read-only). Writes feedback to isolated D1. No R2, no Worker, no Wrangler, no remote deployment.

scripts.dev: echo 'ERROR: Use npm start (after npm run build) to run the local server. Wrangler dev is not supported for this package.' && exit 1
scripts.deploy: echo 'ERROR: This package must never be deployed. It is a localhost-only POC with live D1 data access.' && exit 1
scripts.wrangler: echo 'ERROR: Wrangler is not available in this package.' && exit 1
